title: test(ui-merge): the governance pins on objectui's workflows retire to their roster rows and root gates; the Node anchor reads the root workflows
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoAqVfFyhsxKuFcEP9YTBj25)_

Part of #25712 (4b PR 2d-2b: the last `ui/scripts/__tests__` files that scan `ui/.github/workflows/` as a population stop reading it).
Part of objectstack#25677.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么:** 2d-2a(#25904)之后,还剩 8 个测试文件把嵌套的 `ui/.github/workflows/` 当作一个总体来扫描。这个目录在 monorepo 里不运行。
  - `doc-version-claims` 和 `check-lockfile-dedupe` 的扫描改成读根目录的 `.github/workflows/`。
  - `ci-setup-pnpm-wiring` 改为断言根目录 4 个 UI job 都通过根目录的 `./.github/actions/setup-pnpm` 安装 pnpm。
  - `dependabot-merge-gate`、`merge-queue-reporting`、`check-lockfile-integrity` 里读 objectui workflow 的 pin 退役,每条都写明由谁承接:路线表的行号,或者根目录现在承担这件事的 gate。其余用例保留。
  - `workflow-cache-save-bound` 和 `labeler-package-coverage` 两个文件整个删除,因为里面每个用例都读 objectui 的 workflow 或 labeler 配置。
  - 按 dispatcher 对 F12 的裁定 **B**,根目录 `labeler.yml` 不加 `ui/` 规则(原因见下)。
- **为什么改:** 2d-3 要删除 `ui/.github/workflows/`,删之前这 8 个文件必须先不依赖它。改完以后,无论 `ui/.github/workflows/` 在不在,保留和修改的 6 个文件都是绿的(本地两种布局都是 96 个用例通过)。
- **风险与代价(含回滚):** 只动测试和一个测试 ledger,不动任何会运行的代码、workflow 或受管面。退役的 pin 都写明了承接方。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **席位意见:**(留空)
- **你要做的:** 无。Tier S,由席位落地。

## 席位核对

(left for the dispatch seat)

## Why

GitHub runs only the repository root's `.github/workflows/`. Since the cutover (#25825), objectui's workflows sit at `ui/.github/workflows/` and run nowhere. 2d-1 (#25879) moved the readers of `ui/.github/workflows/ci.yml`. 2d-2a (#25904) took 18 of the 27 files that scan the workflow directory as a population. This PR takes the other 8, the governance files. `check-pre-install-import-graph` stays with 2d-3, because its gate, not just its test, derives its population from the nested workflows.

The rule is the same as in 2d-1 and 2d-2a. A pin is either retargeted to the root workflows by path, or retired with a comment naming who carries its subject. Nothing is skipped and nothing is folded into a root workflow.

## What changes

- **`dependabot-merge-gate`.** Three groups of pins read objectui's `pull_request` workflows through `./workflow-checks.ts`: the bucket partition, the exemption control for `RENAMED_SINCE_4959`, and the six pins on `dependabot-auto-merge.yml`. They retire as roster **row 9** (→ sub-issue 4). The gate's one caller is that workflow, which runs nowhere, and no root workflow merges Dependabot pull requests. Everything that judges a check-run list stays: the #4959 counterfactual, absence, the optional bucket, `waitForGate`, `main()`, the verdict text, the check-runs-only boundary, and the reasons.
- **`merge-queue-reporting`.** The #3523 step 1 pins, the floor derived from `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` (`deriveMergeGroupFloor()` and its three cases) and the step 2 pins all read objectui's workflows. The root gates already carry both #3523 holes, for every context the repository requires today: `scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` (`check:required-contexts`) holds each required context's workflow to a `merge_group:` trigger (assertion 6) and to a `pull_request` trigger with no path filter (assertion 7), and `check:workflow-status-functions` pins the filter contract's status-function half. Both run in `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`. The CI page describe stays and now scans `MUST_SUBSCRIBE_MERGE_GROUP` alone.
- **`check-lockfile-dedupe`, `check-lockfile-integrity`.** The wiring pins on objectui's `lockfile-dedupe.yml` and `lockfile-integrity.yml` retire as roster **rows 18 and 19** (kept, follow-up port, re-aimed at the one root `pnpm-lock.yaml`). The dedupe test's live-reading scan now reads the root workflows through `helpers/root-ci.ts`, and `LIVE_READING_SITES` drops the nested workflow. The population controls and the classification cases stay.
- **`ci-setup-pnpm-wiring`.** Three population cases swept objectui's workflows for calls to `scripts/ci-setup-pnpm.sh`, and they retire. A new describe asks the same questions of the four root `* UI` jobs, by path: no `corepack` outside the shared setup, and checkout before `./.github/actions/setup-pnpm` before the first `pnpm`. All four hold at this head. The script and its self-test stay; no root job calls the script.
- **`doc-version-claims`.** The `node-version` anchor (`WORKFLOWS_DIR`) is now the root `.github/workflows/` (`rootWorkflowsDir`). All 56 root declarations read `'22'`. The census cross-check's key counter now skips whole-line YAML comments: root `half-state-patrol.yml:111` quotes a commented setup example, and counting it would read the parser's correct silence as a lost lane.
- **Deleted: `workflow-cache-save-bound.test.ts` (11 cases) and `labeler-package-coverage.test.ts` (7 cases).** Every case read objectui's workflows or `ui/.github/labeler.yml`. Their carriers are in rows 7 and 8 of the table.
- **`ui/scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs`.** It drops the deleted labeler test's entry, and the `walker:` of `merge-queue-reporting` (its `readdirSync(workflowDir)` is gone).

### F12 as ruled → B, labels absent

The dispatcher first ruled that this PR should add the `ui/` globs to the root `.github/labeler.yml` and retarget `labeler-package-coverage` to it. Measuring first showed that this would turn root Auto Label red on every pull request touching `ui/packages`:

- Root `Auto Label` (`pr-automation.yml`) is not `actions/labeler`. It is `node scripts/pr-labels.mjs --paths`, an additive POST with `pull-requests: write` only, and `pr-labels.mjs` treats any 4xx as fatal ("a `422` is a label that does not exist in the repo").
- 28 of the 32 labels in `ui/.github/labeler.yml` do not exist in this repository's label registry:
  - `package: core`, `package: types`, `package: react`, `package: components`, `package: app-shell`, `package: auth`, `package: cli`, `package: collaboration`, `package: create-plugin`, `package: fields`, `package: i18n`, `package: layout`, `package: mobile`, `package: permissions`, `package: providers`, `package: react-runtime`, `package: runner`, `package: sdui-parser`;
  - `plugin`, `plugin: charts`, `plugin: editor`, `plugin: kanban`, `plugin: markdown`;
  - `data-adapter`, `configuration`, `examples`, `apps`, `breaking-change`.

  Only `documentation`, `tests`, `dependencies` and `ci/cd` exist.

The dispatcher re-ruled **B**:
- no `ui/` globs go into the root labeler;
- the test's pins retire as roster **row 14**, because the monorepo label taxonomy belongs to sub-issue 4;
- `ui/.github/labeler.yml` stays as an inert config until sub-issue 4 rules, and 2d-3 lists it as "kept, pending sub-issue 4".

### Disposition table (8 files)

| # | File | Retired | Kept / retargeted | Carried by now |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `dependabot-merge-gate` | `found the workflows and the shard matrix`, `classifies every produced check exactly once`, `requires only contexts whose workflow carries NO path filter`, `marks optional exactly those blocking contexts whose workflow IS path-filtered`; the exemption-control half of `classifies every context the incident produced`; `the workflow cannot merge without consulting the gate` (6 cases on `dependabot-auto-merge.yml`) | the #4959 counterfactual (incident classification included), absence, optional bucket, `waitForGate`, `main()`, legibility, boundary, reasons | roster **row 9** (→ sub-issue 4) |
| 2 | `merge-queue-reporting` | step 1 (3 cases), the derived floor (3 cases and `deriveMergeGroupFloor()`), step 2 (3 `it.each` over `ci.yml`/`lint.yml` and the 2 fail-OPEN cases) | the CI page describe (4 cases), scanning the map | root `check:required-contexts` assertions 6 and 7, and `check:workflow-status-functions` (`Lint · CI, release & engine gates`) |
| 3 | `check-lockfile-dedupe` | has a workflow, `--report-only`, path-filtered, no `merge_group`, shared pnpm setup | live-reading scan **retargeted** to root `.github/workflows/`; population controls; classification | roster **row 18** (kept, follow-up port) |
| 4 | `check-lockfile-integrity` | `exists and runs the gate`, `checks out deep enough to have a merge base` | classification | roster **row 19** (kept, follow-up port) |
| 5 | `ci-setup-pnpm-wiring` | `no workflow runs corepack outside the shared script`, `every workflow that invokes pnpm also runs the shared setup`, `every job that calls the setup script checks the repository out first` | **retargeted:** the four root `* UI` jobs, by path, against `./.github/actions/setup-pnpm`; the script's own cases | root `type-check-ui`, `test-ui`, `lint-ui`, `build-e2e-ui` |
| 6 | `doc-version-claims` | (none) | **retargeted:** the `node-version` anchor reads root `.github/workflows/`; the census skips comment lines | root `.github/workflows/` |
| 7 | `workflow-cache-save-bound` (deleted) | the 7 population cases (split restore/save, bounded and non-fatal saves, save after the last command, crowding) | (none) | #25869 row F1 (bound the root ui jobs' saves the objectui way; F11, the combined pnpm-store cache, is F1's scope) |
| | | ceiling pins: `ci.yml::e2e` ≤30, `lint.yml::lint` 25 | | root `build-e2e-ui` (ceiling 45) and `lint-ui` (ceiling 30); see follow-up F13 |
| | | `ci.yml::docs` ≤15, `live-e2e.yml` ≤40, `performance-budget.yml` 25 | | roster rows **7** (Build Docs), **17**, **22** (kept, follow-up port) |
| | | `check-links.yml` 20, `cross-repo-issue-closer.yml` 20, `labeler.yml` 20, `changelog.yml` unbounded | | roster rows **6**, **8**, **14**, **2** (→ sub-issue 4) |
| 8 | `labeler-package-coverage` (deleted) | all 7 (lit control, every package labelled, no dangling rule, `package: X` spelling, exemption lists, docs tree, `issues: write`) | (none); `ui/.github/labeler.yml` stays, inert | roster **row 14** (→ sub-issue 4); F12 → B, above |

### Follow-up rows (not folded here)

- **F13.** The root `lint-ui` (`timeout-minutes: 30`) and `build-e2e-ui` (`45`) ceilings came over without the derivations objectui wrote beside its 25 and 30, and nothing pins them. #25869's F1 seat touches the same jobs.
- **F14.** The CI page's `## Merge Queue` section (`ui/content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`) still says `merge-queue-reporting.test.ts` derives the floor from `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS`. This PR retires that derivation. The page as a whole describes objectui's CI. It is for the dispatcher to route.
- **F15.** `ui/scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` has no caller, and its `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` names objectui's check names. Eight other test files still import it as a classification source (`check-required-check-set`, `check-governed-queue-guard` and `check-readme-exports` among them). Sub-issue 4 decides whether to port it or delete it.

### What 2d-3 still owes (not here)

- `check-pre-install-import-graph`, `check-action-ref-convention` (its gate scans the nested workflow directory), `check-merge-queue-head` and `workflow-checks.ts`, and the 24 single-workflow readers.
- It moves the three `ui/.github/prompts/*.prompt.md` files to root `.github/prompts/`, with a separate prompts root for `check:prompt-keys`.
- It deletes `ui/.github/dependabot.yml`, and deletes `ui/.github/workflows/**` once #25880 lands.
- It lists `ui/.github/labeler.yml` as kept, pending sub-issue 4.

## Verification

This head is `main` `2a728ba2` (with #25904) plus this commit. The test runs below were taken on `main` `cb0a2fcf` with 2d-2a and this commit applied. That tree's `ui/` and `scripts/pm/` are byte-identical to this head's: the only commit between them is #25830, which touches neither. The derived gates were re-run on this head. Test runs are from `ui/`, per `ui/AGENTS.md`.

| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| The 6 modified test files, `ui/.github/workflows/` present | 6 files, 96 tests, all passed |
| The same 6 with `ui/.github/workflows/` moved aside (the 2d-3 layout) | 6 files, 96 tests, all passed |
| Whole `scripts/__tests__` suite, `--shard=1/4` through `4/4`, under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` | 5,370 passed, 1 failed, 2 skipped |
| `pnpm type-check:scripts` | the one error is `packages/components/src/renderers/action/resolve-icon.ts(265,69)` TS2339, identical on unmodified `main` here; none in a touched file |
| `pnpm exec eslint --max-warnings=0` (touched files), `lint:coverage`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`; root `pnpm check:test-source-alias` | all exit 0 |

The one suite failure is the base red riding `main`: `check-pre-install-import-graph`, `unresolved: scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs`. Main's push run 40264138159 is red on the same row. It clears in 2d-3 with the nested workflows.

Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`): 18 families from this PR's 9 paths, 1830 changed lines. All 18 exit 0 at this head, and `--ran` reconciles 18 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The same 18 also exited 0 on the `cb0a2fcf` tree. The slowest were `check:query-options-erasure` (567 s), `check-comment-mask-corpus` (326 s) and `check:engine-double-contract` (140 s), measured on a shared box.

Push-environment battery (`GITHUB_ACTIONS=true GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=push node scripts/pm/check-dispatch-gates.mjs`, both tiers): "✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 2182 cases pass." (fast 1917 in 403.6 s, slow 265 in 1124.4 s).
